notes.title: 2/8 update
notes.content:
- Fixed save bug
- Easing the difficulty of the final mission
- Difficulty eased for 22x22 and 25x25

notes.title: 2/6 update
notes.content:
- English release
- Addition of missions where you can see illustrations
- Add achievements
- Fixed a bug where 22x22 and 25x25 high difficulty stages were mixed in a 20x20 tab

If 22x22 and 25x25 are in Level9 uncleared state, even if 20x20 and Level13 and above are in a cleared state, they must be cleared again to open.

notes.title: 1/1 update
notes.content:
ver 1.2.0

-It is now possible to save interrupt data directly from the game screen.
-Added 4 achievements

Even if you meet the conditions for the achievements added this time before the update, the achievements will not be released.
Again, you'll need to complete the achievement's requirements.

notes.title: 12/28 update
notes.content:
ver1.1.0

- Renamed "Standard" to "Very Hard"
- Addition of "Easy", "Medium" and "Hard" difficulty levels
